actual_comparison.front: The 1.00m centre opening is clear through worktop and lower shelf bands. Thick tan wings sit on charcoal posts with visible grounded feet and a low petrol tie. Screen bezel and scanner lens are readable; scanner overlaps the screen bottom in projection, while their separation is visible in quarter.
actual_comparison.side: Monitor body thickness, stem and base are visible. The tape roll has a visible open axial hole, a cutter/pedestal and no solid hub. Front/rear legs and lower shelf remain supported.
actual_comparison.rear: The monitor and printer have complete closed backs. Device stems/bases land on wings; the frame, shelf ends and feet remain complete from behind.
actual_comparison.quarter: Both side wings, recessed scanner/display/printer mouth, paper strip and open annular tape roll read as dimensional boxy components. Matte charcoal, petrol and warm tan follow the dedicated R04 PACK reference.

approved_adaptation: R04 art authority is retained for palette, boxy thickness, grounded frame and four devices. The illustrative solid centre tabletop/shelf is replaced by two tan side wings and an open 1.00m U-shaped working channel, connected below by a low front cross-tie, as approved in P08.1/P08.2 and verified with the accepted L08 spur in P08.4. No solid top bridge closes the belt channel.
